comparison.baseline_gear_drag_change: Zero-change assumption in the mass-only fuel scenario. Gross rotational work is reported separately.

same_blank.basis: Scale both blank dimensions with the saved gear similarity factor and use the same nominal stock in both routes. Saw kerf, rejects, supplier availability, actual steelmaking route and batch data remain open.
same_blank.stock_profile: Inherited Worldsteel Global Engineering Steel Other, 2024 inventory, 2026 release, A1-A3. A generic engineering steel proxy for each research card, independent of its simulated heat-treatment state.

milling.catalogue_basis: OSG WXL-EMS, four flutes, dimensions p. 13 and ordinary side milling in the up-to-32 HRC group p. 42. Source speeds and feeds serve as pre-final-heat-treatment planning proxies for the low-alloy steel blanks.
milling.scope: Candidate route for convex circular and superellipse profiles. A diameter, curvature and flute-reach screen precedes the volume-equivalent model. Sector fillets require separate toolpath evidence. Apply the inherited 20MnCr5 Kienzle coefficient as a common soft steel process proxy across the nine research cards.

sector_rest_milling.catalogue_basis: OSG WXL-LN-EMS four-flute dimensions pp. 19–21 and contouring and slotting figures for the up-to-32 HRC group pp. 49–51. Use them as planning inputs for the two-face corner and wall pass.
sector_rest_milling.scope: Conditional two-face rest-milling plan. Use the broad cutter for the swept bulk and a catalogued long-neck cutter for the residual walls and corners. A sampled two-dimensional access check and an axial reach check support the inventory estimate. Qualification requires CAM, holder clearance, two-face alignment, stiffness, tool life, finish and actual machine evidence.

wire_edm.basis: Electricity, removal rate and water allocation are from the documented 11 mm AISI P20 wire-EDM case. Transfer by estimated kerf volume as a separate benchmark, with kerf widths and lead/drill dimensions assumed. The machine envelope is from the MV2400 series and establishes dimensions only. Actual power, flushing, lead-ins, quality, drilling and any trim cuts require manufacturing evidence.

commercial_cases.evidence: Ricardo-AEA Table 3.17, VECTO simulation; diesel-equivalent litres derived
Ricardo-AEA Table 3.17, VECTO simulation; diesel-equivalent litres derived

road_scenarios.distance_basis: Use the pinned Phase 3 passenger exposure traces as reference scenarios. For commercial vehicles the declared cycle-count-per-km values are independent sensitivity inputs. A vehicle and gear position need their own observed or modeled exposure to establish the road equivalent of the Atlas test.
